title: "About"

I am a mixed-methods sociologist and MSc Sociology candidate at KU Leuven. My work combines quantitative, qualitative, and computational approaches to study social inequality, migration, intergroup relations, discrimination, education, and adolescent wellbeing.

I am particularly interested in using survey research and statistical modelling to investigate socially and policy-relevant questions. My experience includes regression analysis, machine learning, text analysis, and web scraping

## Research interests

- Migration and intergroup relations
- Inter-minority relations
- Intergroup contact and discrimination
- Social inequality
- Adolescent wellbeing
- Quantitative and mixed-methods research
